hypotheses.title: Subindustry Normalized Fair Value Liabilities Quarterly Surge Inversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Fair value accounting reports ongoing valuations of assets and liabilities. A recent 63-day increase in Level 1 fair value of liabilities (fn_liab_fair_val_l1_a) normalized by liability scale indicates escalating market-quoted debt obligations and heightened refinancing costs. Shorting stocks with surging fair-value liabilities within each subindustry captures the subsequent underperformance driven by deteriorating credit quality and lower forward profitability.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if surging liabilities correspond to growth-accretive leveraged acquisitions that outperform peers cross-sectionally.

candidates.rationale: Normalized 63-day relative surge in fair value liabilities inverted and ranked cross-sectionally by subindustry
